text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions at gains, but a gain versus my average cost does not tell me whether selling is best; I should avoid taking profits just for the satisfaction of locking them in.","A loss can feel painful, but my purchase price is in the past; I should assess each holding on its merits rather than hold it simply to avoid realizing a loss.","Recent price moves do not predict what comes next, and doing nothing is an option; I should trade deliberately instead of reacting to daily fluctuations."]}
